name.description: Name of the volume to mount.

mountPath.description: Path in the container the volume is mounted at.

readOnly.description: Whether the volume is mounted read-only.

recursiveReadOnly.description: Whether the read-only mount is applied recursively to submounts.

subPath.description: Path inside the volume to mount instead of its root.

subPathExpr.description: Like `subPath`, but expanded from environment variables of the container. Mutually exclusive with `subPath`.
